title: Magazine p. 59: Ice flake floating off the X-15 rocket plane (NASA photo 76-H-139)
description: Photocopied magazine page with a tall, grainy photograph (numbered 34) of scattered specks, captioned "Flake of ice floating off of the X-15 rocket plane. Some investigators call this a 'large UFO'. NASA photo 76-H-139." Article text explains the Skylab airstrip identification, the X-15 "fleets of UFOs" reports as ice flecks ("fireflies"), and lists UFO quotations attributed to astronauts. A handwritten note reads "plate 34."
